title: AI Lead
description:
This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in how British Heart Foundation (BHF) identifies, prioritises and progresses artificial intelligence (AI) opportunities across the organisation.


As our AI Lead, you’ll manage BHF’s Microsoft-first, enterprise pipeline of AI opportunities, creating a clear and transparent view of demand, value and help us make informed decisions about where to focus our investment and capacity.


Working across BHF, you’ll bring together strategic priorities and ideas from colleagues, helping turn opportunities into clearly defined use cases. You’ll work closely with specialists across product, delivery, data, architecture, information security, privacy, procurement, legal, change and responsible AI governance.


You’ll help identify where AI could deliver the greatest value, challenge proposed solutions, and ensure approved opportunities are routed to the right delivery teams with clear ownership and next steps. You’ll also provide insight into the health and progress of our AI portfolio, helping senior stakeholders make evidence-led decisions.


This is an opportunity to help shape how BHF approaches AI at an enterprise level, ensuring innovation remains aligned with our strategy, responsible AI principles, security and data requirements, while maintaining a strong focus on measurable value.


About you


You’ll have significant experience managing a complex portfolio, pipeline or demand function within an organisation involving multiple stakeholders, with a track record of assessing and prioritising opportunities against strategic value, feasibility, risk, cost and capacity.


You’ll also bring:

  • Strong knowledge of portfolio, product or programme management, including demand management, prioritisation, governance and delivery lifecycles.
  • A good understanding of AI and automation opportunities, limitations and delivery considerations. You don’t need to be a developer, but you’ll be comfortable working with technical specialists.
  • Experience turning ambiguous ideas into clear problem statements, outcomes, options and practical next steps.
  • Experience contributing to effective governance, decision-making forums and portfolio reporting across multiple teams.
  • Strong analytical and judgement skills, with the confidence to constructively challenge priorities and recommendations.
  • The ability to use portfolio data to identify duplication, dependencies, bottlenecks and opportunities for reuse.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to communicate complex information clearly to senior and non-technical audiences.
  • An understanding of responsible AI, information security, data protection, architecture and risk considerations relevant to enterprise AI.
  • ?The ability to work collaboratively across business and technology teams and influence others without relying on direct authority.


Experience working with AI, digital, data, automation or technology-enabled transformation portfolios would be an advantage.


Belonging at BHF


We celebrate and value the diversity of the communities we serve, recognising that embracing different perspectives and backgrounds strengthens our organisation and drives innovation. By fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and supported, we are better equipped to achieve our mission of helping people have a healthier heart for longer.


To hear from our people, check out Belonging at BHF.


Our people are at the heart of everything we do. By funding research across six decades, we’ve helped keep millions of hearts beating and millions of families together. We’re investing in ground-breaking research that will get us closer than ever to a world where everyone has a healthier heart for longer.


Working arrangements


This is a hybrid role, where your work will be split between your home and at least one day per week, on average, in our London office (NW1 7AW). This may vary from time to time, so you’ll need to work flexibly to unlock your best work for our cause.


Interview process


Interviews for this role will follow the below process:

  • Initial 20-30 minute MS Teams call with the hiring manager, these will be held w/c 30th November
  • In person, at our London office, panel based interview,. which will incorporate a presentation, held Wednesday 9th December
  • Virtual stakeholder panel session, held on Friday 11th or Monday 14th December.

How to apply


It’s quick and easy to apply for a role at BHF. Just click on the apply button below. You’ll need an up-to-date CV and supporting statement.


Our recruitment processes are fair, accessible and inclusive. BHF uses anonymous CV software as part of the application journey.


We support responsible use of AI to help shape your application. By applying for a role at BHF, you confirm that your application is authentic and reflects your own skills and experience, to ensure everyone is assessed fairly.


Should you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, at either application or interview stage, please contact us.
